name: personality
description: The personality system call sets or retrieves the execution domain of a process, which affects how the kernel maps signal numbers and emulates behaviors of other UNIX-like systems. If the persona argument is not 0xffffffff, it sets the new domain; otherwise, it returns the current one.

parameters.name: persona
parameters.description: The value to set as the new personality, or 0xffffffff to retrieve the current personality without changing it.

return_value.success: Returns the previous persona on success
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The kernel was unable to change the personality.
